utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Nell, thanks for keeping an ear out—please do spread the word, and I’ll see you Saturday at the front porch for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Will do — I’ll pass it along and I’ll be there Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Nell—really appreciate it. See you Saturday at the front porch for the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s definitely this Saturday at the front porch, right? If you still need helpers, I can stop by and confirm what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, this Saturday at the front porch. I still need helpers to gather a hammer, screwdriver set, and any spare tape first—thanks for checking in.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — Saturday at the front porch. I’ll stop by and confirm what’s needed for the hammer, screwdriver set, and tape.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll drop them off tomorrow afternoon, and if you need anything else for Saturday, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks. What time tomorrow afternoon works best for the drop-off?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Around 3 should be fine for me—I'll swing by then with the wrench set and screwdriver.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me — I can be there around 9, and I’ll help coordinate the school schedule around it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, 9 works — I’ll have the porch ready and we can start with the tools first. Thanks for helping coordinate.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — I’ll swing by at 9 and help line up the school drop-off/pickup around the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks—that helps. I’ll wait on the exact time, but I can bring repair items for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Hana. The repair drive starts Saturday morning at the front porch, and we’re taking small repair items like tools, fasteners, and basic hardware.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it—Saturday morning at the front porch. I’ll bring some small repair items and see if you need help too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it’s picking up a few more donations today.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good to hear—can you tell me what’s been added and when the loading is happening?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard a few more tools and some spare tape got added, and the loading should happen later today once everything’s gathered.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — sounds like tools are the priority, then Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Right, let’s get the tools together first, and I’ll keep spreading the word about Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Actually, it’s Sunday at the community center now. Let’s keep telling folks to bring the tools first.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Uli—what location should I note next for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: The front porch again this Saturday, if you could note that down. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—front porch again this Saturday, and I’ll note that down.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks — I could use that. If you can, just keep reminding folks it’s this Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I will — I’m also checking the timing so folks know when to come by, and I’ll try to get the details posted clearly.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Pia — that helps a lot. Just keep the porch time clear, since I get a little mixed up if details change.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Rosa — I’m a little late, but I can help spread the repair drive details around the neighborhood too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Dane — I really appreciate that. Please let folks know it’s now Sunday at the community center, not Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll tell everyone it’s Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Will do — I’ll send the repair drive details over, and I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks Oren. I’m still gathering tools, so please send the details when you can.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely — I’ll send the repair drive details over soon, and I’ll flag anything that changes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Tess — I’m still nailing down the start time, but it’ll be this Saturday on the front porch. We’re definitely taking tools and spare parts, and I’d love any help you can offer.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing—I’ll swing by the repair drive and check what’s still needed, then I’ll pass along the latest.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Tess — I really appreciate it. If you see anything we still need, just let me know and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We still need to gather the tools first—hammer, screwdriver set, and any spare tape. After that, we can head to the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—what time should I bring the tools over, and do you still need any tape?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Could you bring them by 9 on Saturday morning? And yes, spare tape would still be really helpful.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: This Saturday at the front porch works best. If you can, please tell neighbors we especially need help with small leaks and broken boards.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Absolutely — I’m a bit late, but I can spread the word about the small leaks and broken boards around the neighborhood too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Dane — that would help a lot. If you can, please mention we’ll meet this Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Hana—what location should I list first for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: List the front porch first—I’m organizing the repair drive there this Saturday. If you want, I can also help note what items to bring.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, I’ve got the front porch first for Saturday. If you’re helping note items, I’ll track those next too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That would help a lot—I'm trying to make it work around school drop-off and pickup. What time were you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I was thinking Saturday morning, around 9 if that works best for drop-off and pickup. I can be there with the wrench set and screwdriver.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 9 works well for me—I can help coordinate around school drop-off and be there then. Thanks for bringing the wrench set and screwdriver.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Oren — I’m still confirming the exact list, but tools and spare parts are definitely in. I’m hoping to get a few helpers for Saturday at the front porch so we can keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good — I’ll be there at 3 with the flyers and help sort the boxes and spare parts. Just send me the final list when you’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks Oren — 3 works great. I’ll send you the final list as soon as I confirm it, and really appreciate you helping sort everything.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can round up the hammer, screwdriver set, and spare tape for Saturday. I’ll let you know if I find anything else useful.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds great, Cleo—thank you. Let me know if you find anything else, and I’ll keep Dane posted.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Will do—I'll check the bin and bring whatever else I can find for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Mostly setup and sorting donations now. I’ll help where needed at the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Leo—setup and sorting at the community center on Sunday sounds good. If anything changes, please remind me; I might miss it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Will do, Noah. I’ll remind you if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Kira — I’m still sorting pickup and drop-off, and I’ll confirm it before Saturday. I’m also making sure the start time and flyer are clear for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — once you’ve confirmed the pickup, drop-off, and start time, let me know and I’ll help if you still need someone.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Kira — I’ll lock down the pickup, drop-off, and start time, then I’ll let you know if I still need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh good, sounds like the repair drive is coming together. If you hear what’s still needed, I can pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep passing along the repair drive details and make sure the biggest repairs are clear to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate that. If you get the list of needed tools or parts, send it my way and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, great—every bit helps. I heard the repair drive’s picking up a few more donations today.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’s good news—sounds like it’s really picking up. I’ll swing by the repair drive and see what’s still needed so I can pass along the latest.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Tess — I really appreciate it. Let me know what you find out at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, not Saturday at the front porch. I’ll let you know if anything else changes.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, Sunday at the community center. I’ll keep an eye out for any changes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — I appreciate it. If you can help spread the word, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Uli—low-key is perfect. I’m still confirming the start time and what we’re accepting, but I’ll let people know it’s this Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. Just let me know the time and what you’re taking, and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll confirm the time and accepted items, then send it your way. Thanks again for helping spread the word about Saturday at the front porch.
